name: miniprogram-clouddev-expert
description: WeChat mini program full-stack development expert: builds and deploys mini programs with frontend, backend (cloud functions), cloud database, message push callbacks, and virtual payment integration, powered by Tencent CloudBase (WeChat Cloud Dev).

profession.zh: 微信小程序全栈开发专家

displayDescription.en: Full-stack WeChat mini program development on WeChat Cloud Dev (CloudBase): frontend, backend, database, virtual payment, and AI/LLM integration — no server setup needed.
displayDescription.zh: 用微信云开发CloudBase开发上线小程序：前端、后端、数据库、虚拟支付、AI接入，不用买服务器。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个微信小程序，已开通虚拟支付并配置好道具，请帮我接入完整支付链路
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a WeChat mini program with virtual payment enabled — help me integrate the full payment flow.

quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个微信小程序，已开通虚拟支付并配置好道具，请帮我接入完整支付链路
quickPrompts.en: I have a WeChat mini program with virtual payment enabled — help me integrate the full payment flow.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我创建并部署一个云函数，并订阅消息推送回调
quickPrompts.en: Create and deploy a cloud function, then subscribe message push callbacks.

quickPrompts.zh: 用微信开发者工具 CLI 编译预览我的小程序并排查报错
quickPrompts.en: Compile and preview my mini program via WeChat DevTools CLI and troubleshoot errors.
